title: 醫療電子隔離電源
titleEn: Isolated power supplies for medical electronics
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究隔離屏障、漏電與系統安全證據；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate isolation barriers, leakage and system safety evidence. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 使用情境
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「使用情境」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for use context.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「醫療電子隔離電源」的「設備與患者界面：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Equipment and patient interface: model and design” in “Isolated power supplies for medical electronics”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「設備與患者界面」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for equipment and patient interface?
options: 隔離要求取決於使用情境及患者連接，不能只看電源瓦數。
低功率醫療設備自然不需隔離分析。
所有隔離額定都自動等於患者保護。
optionsEn: Isolation depends on use and patient connection, not merely supply wattage.
Low-power medical equipment needs no isolation analysis.
Every isolation rating automatically equals patient protection.
quiz.explanation: 隔離要求取決於使用情境及患者連接，不能只看電源瓦數。 畫出患者、操作者、外接設備與市電邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation depends on use and patient connection, not merely supply wattage. Map patient, operator, peripherals and mains boundaries.

steps.title: 設備與患者界面：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Equipment and patient interface: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「設備與患者界面」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in equipment and patient interface, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。畫出患者、操作者、外接設備與市電邊界。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「隔離要求取決於使用情境及患者連接，不能只看電源瓦數。」和待排除假說「低功率醫療設備自然不需隔離分析。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Map patient, operator, peripherals and mains boundaries. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Isolation depends on use and patient connection, not merely supply wattage.” with the hypothesis to reject “Low-power medical equipment needs no isolation analysis.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：畫出患者、操作者、外接設備與市電邊界。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Map patient, operator, peripherals and mains boundaries. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 畫出患者、操作者、外接設備與市電邊界。
steps.observationEn: Map patient, operator, peripherals and mains boundaries.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：低功率醫療設備自然不需隔離分析。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
